//: Your own commands in Files' right-click menu. Copy this to ~/.config/pleamar/vitreus-files-actions.json and change it.
//on: on: files, folders, both, or background (a click on the empty part of a folder). patterns: shell patterns for files (optional). many: true to offer it with several picked (optional).
//command: In the command, %f is the item (the folder, for background), %F every one picked, %d the folder in view, %n the item's name: each comes quoted. It runs through sh, in the folder in view.

actions.name: Shrink to 1600 px
actions.command: for f in %F; do magick "$f" -resize '1600x1600>' "${f%.*}-small.jpg"; done
